BEGIN;

-- ایجاد کلینیک آزمایشی
INSERT INTO clinics (
    name,
    phone,
    address,
    timezone
)
SELECT
    'کلینیک آزمایشی',
    '02100000000',
    'آدرس آزمایشی کلینیک',
    'Asia/Tehran'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM clinics
    WHERE name = 'کلینیک آزمایشی'
);

-- ایجاد پزشک آزمایشی
WITH selected_clinic AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM clinics
    WHERE name = 'کلینیک آزمایشی'
    ORDER BY id
    LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO doctors (
    clinic_id,
    full_name,
    specialty,
    default_appointment_minutes,
    buffer_minutes
)
SELECT
    id,
    'دکتر آزمایشی',
    'پزشک عمومی',
    20,
    5
FROM selected_clinic
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM doctors
    WHERE clinic_id = selected_clinic.id
      AND full_name = 'دکتر آزمایشی'
);

-- ایجاد خدمت آزمایشی
WITH selected_clinic AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM clinics
    WHERE name = 'کلینیک آزمایشی'
    ORDER BY id
    LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO services (
    clinic_id,
    name,
    description,
    duration_minutes,
    price,
    currency
)
SELECT
    id,
    'ویزیت عمومی',
    'ویزیت اولیه پزشک عمومی',
    20,
    500000,
    'IRR'
FROM selected_clinic
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM services
    WHERE clinic_id = selected_clinic.id
      AND name = 'ویزیت عمومی'
);

-- تعریف برنامه حضور پزشک از شنبه تا چهارشنبه
WITH selected_doctor AS (
    SELECT d.id
    FROM doctors d
    INNER JOIN clinics c ON c.id = d.clinic_id
    WHERE c.name = 'کلینیک آزمایشی'
      AND d.full_name = 'دکتر آزمایشی'
    ORDER BY d.id
    LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO doctor_schedules (
    doctor_id,
    weekday,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    slot_duration_minutes
)
SELECT
    selected_doctor.id,
    schedule.weekday,
    schedule.start_time::TIME,
    schedule.end_time::TIME,
    20
FROM selected_doctor
CROSS JOIN (
    VALUES
        (6, '09:00', '13:00'),
        (7, '09:00', '13:00'),
        (1, '09:00', '13:00'),
        (2, '09:00', '13:00'),
        (3, '09:00', '13:00')
) AS schedule(weekday, start_time, end_time)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM doctor_schedules existing_schedule
    WHERE existing_schedule.doctor_id = selected_doctor.id
      AND existing_schedule.weekday = schedule.weekday
      AND existing_schedule.start_time = schedule.start_time::TIME
      AND existing_schedule.end_time = schedule.end_time::TIME
);

COMMIT;

-- نمایش نتیجه
SELECT
    c.name AS clinic_name,
    d.full_name AS doctor_name,
    d.specialty,
    s.name AS service_name,
    CASE ds.weekday
        WHEN 1 THEN 'دوشنبه'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'سه‌شنبه'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'چهارشنبه'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'پنج‌شنبه'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'جمعه'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'شنبه'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'یکشنبه'
    END AS working_day,
    TO_CHAR(ds.start_time, 'HH24:MI') AS start_time,
    TO_CHAR(ds.end_time, 'HH24:MI') AS end_time,
    ds.slot_duration_minutes
FROM clinics c
INNER JOIN doctors d
    ON d.clinic_id = c.id
INNER JOIN services s
    ON s.clinic_id = c.id
INNER JOIN doctor_schedules ds
    ON ds.doctor_id = d.id
WHERE c.name = 'کلینیک آزمایشی'
  AND d.full_name = 'دکتر آزمایشی'
ORDER BY
    CASE ds.weekday
        WHEN 6 THEN 1
        WHEN 7 THEN 2
        WHEN 1 THEN 3
        WHEN 2 THEN 4
        WHEN 3 THEN 5
        WHEN 4 THEN 6
        WHEN 5 THEN 7
    END;
